interpretation_rules: encrypted transport is never presented as malicious by itself
zero, no_sample, not_computable, unavailable and forbidden are distinct display states
every risk statement displays source, rule or model version, contribution and limitation
field-level redaction is visible and never replaced with fabricated values

invariants: all sections share one tenant, time window, as_of and snapshot identity
ClickHouse session and feature facts remain authoritative while OpenSearch, when used, is a bounded search projection only
SNI, JA3 or certificate presence alone never creates a malicious verdict
every tunnel, exfiltration or anomaly statement binds its rule or model version and evidence references
entropy and randomness values bind sample size, method ID and method version; empty input is not numeric zero
source failure, no sample, not computable, field denial and a measured zero cannot collapse to the same value
each raw reference is tenant-bound and drillable only when the caller holds the field and object permission
partial or stale sources remain explicit in the top-level meta and the affected section
domain.compensation: disable the snapshot adapter, restore the six legacy read endpoints, retain source facts and audit records, and invalidate only derived snapshot caches

data.migration: additive snapshot contract only under T1-M09-N006/N007; legacy encrypted read endpoints remain available

negative_tests: tenant query parameters cannot override the authenticated tenant
a caller without pcap:read sees an explicit forbidden raw_reference section and no object key
a caller without pcap:download cannot turn a reference into an object URL
OpenSearch results with a different tenant or stale projection watermark are rejected

journeys: one-hour tenant snapshot with all sections
stop_conditions: response or dependency budget is exceeded without truncation, a source watermark is absent, or server P99 exceeds the approved candidate baseline

tests: G0 canonical owner, ID, schema, route, action and legacy API inventory
G1 same-window snapshot identity, section shape and measured-zero versus no-sample semantics
G2 tenant and field-permission negatives including raw reference and download denial
G3 ClickHouse authority with PostgreSQL version, OpenSearch projection and MinIO reference reconciliation
G4 rule and model version change, dependency outage, partial result and stale watermark
G5 existing K8s candidate query, bounded performance, rollback and observation
G6 Windows Chrome live-default page states and evidence drilldown
evidence: candidate-bound request and response hashes, per-section source counts and watermarks, rule and model versions, permission negatives, dependency failures, performance profile, rollback receipt and browser journey
